evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce \textsc{BuySideFlow}, a benchmark of 408 practitioner-derived Chinese-language tasks spanning equities, funds, fixed income, and macroeconomics over a fixed snapshot from a licensed production financial database.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) can generate SQL and SQL--Python workflows for investment research, but ensuring point-in-time (PIT) validity remains challenging.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate nine agent configurations on all tasks, with result accuracy ranging from 16.2\% to 36.8\%.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: An audit of 900 runs on 100 shared tasks confirms PIT violations in 193 of the 380 runs that pass result checks (50.8\%), showing that output agreement alone does not establish temporal validity.
